name: I Don't Need an iPhone [idni]
description: “I Don't Need an iPhone” (2020) by Whistlegraph — a whistlegraph: a graphic score in which every drawn line is a sung line, and the finished drawing teaches you how to perform it. This token is the code itself — the same string is the work's URL (whistlegraph.org/idni) and its name (idni.whistlegraph.eth). When Whistlegraph Dot Org releases music derived from this graph, its holder receives the first edition and a royalty split. The matching 2022 Feral File video edition remains a distinct historical artifact of the Ten Whistlegraphs exhibition.
